name: Air Filter Warning
teaser: Tired of forgetting about air filter when you exit the game? Maybe this mod will help you save your precious FP-100 filters.
description_html:
Air Filter Warning

A simple mod that adds warning message before exiting the game when air filter is still working in your hideout.

SPT 3.10.5 version is available on GitHub

Installation

  1. Make sure that SPT Client is not running
  2. Press download button on top of this page or head to releases page on GitHub
  3. Download correct version for your SPT
  4. Open zip file
  5. Drag and drop BepInEx directory to your SPT directory
  6. Start game and make sure that mod is working

Old Versions

You can download other versions of this mod (3.10.5, 3.11) on GitHub
